crossRefs.note: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go…
Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from…
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered…
he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

translations.web: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
translations.bsb: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
translations.kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
translations.asv: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way to walk in.
